evals.prompt: Create a full brand kit for my consulting firm called Meridian Partners. We're a B2B strategy consultancy focused on helping mid-market companies with growth strategy. Use navy blue and gold colors, professional/corporate personality. I want the core brand kit (logo variations, brand guidelines, color palette, typography guide), plus social media assets for LinkedIn and Twitter, and a business card concept. Use an abstract compass-inspired mark for the logo symbol.
evals.expected_output: Generates a company brand kit with: primary logo, monochrome logo (via /modify), reversed logo (via /modify), icon-mark, favicon, LinkedIn and Twitter assets, business card concept. Also writes brand-guidelines.md, color-palette.md, and typography-guide.md. All staged in ./brandkit/ with subdirectories (logos/, social/, collateral/, docs/).
expectations: Uses the company brand kit flow, not the app/product flow
Generates primary logo first before deriving variations
Creates monochrome logo using /modify endpoint on primary logo, not a separate /generate call
Creates reversed (white) logo using /modify endpoint on primary logo, not a separate /generate call
Creates an icon-mark (derived from primary logo via resize or /modify)
Generates favicon with --sizes and --ico flags
Generates LinkedIn cover image at approximately 2048x512 dimensions
Generates Twitter header image at approximately 2048x682 dimensions
Social profile pictures are derived from the icon-mark via resize, not generated separately
Generates a business card concept with placeholder lines instead of real text
Writes a brand-guidelines.md file in ./brandkit/docs/
Writes a color-palette.md file with hex codes and RGB values in ./brandkit/docs/
Writes a typography-guide.md file with font recommendations in ./brandkit/docs/
Color palette document includes CSS custom properties section
Typography guide includes a type scale table
All image assets use navy/blue and gold color descriptions in prompts
Stages all outputs in ./brandkit/ with subdirectories (logos/, social/, collateral/, docs/)

evals.prompt: I need a logo and favicon for my todo app called TaskFlow. Use blue tones, minimal/flat style, and use a flowing checkmark as the symbol.
evals.expected_output: Follows the existing app/product flow. Generates a logo at 1024x1024 with --sizes 512 for the app icon, and a favicon with --sizes and --ico. Uses flat ./brandkit/ directory (no subdirectories). Does NOT generate brand guidelines documents or logo variations.
expectations: Uses the app/product flow, not the company brand kit flow
Generates a logo using generate_asset.py with --prompt flag
Logo prompt includes 'flat' or 'minimal' style and 'blue' colors and 'checkmark'
Generates logo at 1024x1024 with --sizes 512 for the app icon
Generates favicon with --sizes flag including 16,32 and --ico flag
Does NOT write brand-guidelines.md or color-palette.md or typography-guide.md
Does NOT generate monochrome or reversed logo variations
Outputs go to flat ./brandkit/ directory, not subdirectories like ./brandkit/logos/

evals.prompt: I need branding for my project called Bloom. It's a wellness and meditation startup.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as ambiguous (could be app or company) and uses AskUserQuestion to ask the user which type of brand kit they need. The question should offer App/Product, Company brand kit, and Just one asset as options.
expectations: Uses AskUserQuestion to ask what type of brand kit the user needs
The question offers at least two options: one for app/product branding and one for company brand kit
Does NOT immediately start generating assets without first determining the brand kit type
Does NOT skip the branching question and assume app or company flow
